agreements: V4 preserves the intended organism: THINK owns live child thought, action, and public outcome; DREAM is disposable waking context; personal SLEEP compiles grounded child experience into a LoRA; bootstrap schooling and audit apparatus are not additional cognitive organs.
Parent prose and repetition-control state must remain outside semantic personal SLEEP, while independently grounded child enactments may enter through ordinary life-evidence rules.

Merge-once immutable births, the sole response-only writer, direct-solution active control plus M0 diagnostic, classified rejected-write behavior, and preservation of committed life are sound design commitments rather than present evidence.
Scientific evaluation must be disposable and reporting-only, whereas private preservation evidence may affect only a staged candidate promotion decision.
Delta_R, Delta_F, Delta_E, replay, repetition, rank, cadence, blindness, canary, and independent-root claims retain the narrow boundaries stated in v4; no scientific result currently exists.
All exact implementation, data, analysis, execution, GPU, claim, publication, and push scopes remain separately byte-bound and human-authorized.

disagreements.issue: The interpretations reconstructed opaque, directional, epoch-scoped, noninterfering meanings for broad visible and derived_only cells, the evaluator, the auditor, the fixed controller, and the first-execution gate; the critic found those meanings absent from or contradicted by the exact proposal bytes.

positions.position: The intended safe meanings can be carried as assumptions and later exact implementation contracts without changing the proposal architecture.

Broad composite visibility, unspecified projections, missing direction and lifecycle, truth/model colocation, an omniscient auditor-to-release path, mixed fixed-controller state, and narrow machine-gate labels are seven proposal-byte blockers.

resolution.rationale: Exact-byte governance cannot import safety-critical capabilities or causal separations from interpreter assumptions. Each of the seven defects creates a live bypass or an unenforced ordering and therefore survives adjudication.
resolution.selected_position: Accept all seven proposal blockers and require a hash-bound successor proposal followed by fresh interpretation, critique, and consensus.
resolution.required_change: Split the composite head into least-authority capabilities; replace derived_only with named directional operations and transitive taint rules; add stage invocation epochs and lifecycle constraints; split model-facing exam execution, truth scoring, and reporting; split blindness and lineage auditors from an external human-authority verifier and release; restrict the fixed controller to immutable outbound lesson bytes, a monotone external cursor, and write-only audit append; and enumerate every first affected action under one fail-closed prerequisite class.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A stage that can read the composite committed head can dereference active weights, life data, parent audit, or repetition state despite separately forbidden cells; loop prose calling the token opaque does not constrain the matrix.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Replace lineage.committed_head visibility with separately typed minimal active-weight READ, eligible-life READ, candidate-handle BIND, and equality-only head CAS capabilities; forbid cross-capability dereference and transitive derivation.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The word derived_only does not define which bytes, counts, identifiers, hashes, timing, errors, or handles are exposed, so it cannot establish noninterference.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Eliminate generic derived_only cells in favor of named READ, WRITE, APPEND, DEREFERENCE, or equality-only BIND capabilities with canonical schemas, error behavior, and direct plus transitive taint expectations.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Undirected visible access allows a producer to read its own prior outputs or another epoch's state, creating feedback absent from the declared loop.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Define the complete stage-by-information-by-operation product and invocation epochs; make each invocation fresh, identify permitted prior-epoch reads explicitly, and fail all undeclared self-read, carryover, derive, or bind paths.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A single deployment evaluator with model weights, public input, hidden truth, transcripts, and prior scientific products can truth-condition generation or adapt evaluation to results.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Create separate fresh model-facing exam executor, truth-bearing mechanical scorer, and reporting aggregator stages: the executor cannot see truth or prior products, the scorer cannot run or modify the model, and reporting cannot feed execution, lineage, or release.

concern_dispositions.rationale: An auditor that sees every information class and authors the release decision is a transitive channel from hidden answers, scores, candidate evidence, parent state, and repetition state into release.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Separate target-blindness audit, lineage/firewall audit, externally supplied human authorization, authority verification, and release control; type their attestations narrowly and prevent any protected input or content-derived selector from reaching the verifier or release controller.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Reading mixed repetition state, live-parent text, or parent-state projections exposes adaptive acquisition, relapse, and self-history signals to a controller claimed to be exogenous.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Give the fixed controller only immutable outbound lesson bytes, a monotone external schedule cursor, and write-only audit append; deny reads of child behavior, outcomes, acquisition, relapse, prior audit, SLEEP, scores, and candidate state.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A required_before value of model_execution cannot enforce prose that also covers tokenizer, data, evaluation, writer, adapter, candidate, promotion, GPU, and external dispatch actions.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Introduce an exact first-affected-action prerequisite and exhaustive dispatcher registry covering every affected CPU/GPU model, tokenizer, generation, evaluation, writer, adapter, candidate, promotion, benchmark, data, and external action; require hash-valid safety receipts before each dispatch.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Capability repair still leaves byte-distinct lineage, support, cache, quarantine, and audit implementations unless their schemas and transaction rules are separately frozen.
concern_dispositions.required_change: After a successor architecture passes and before implementation, bind exact descriptor and capability schemas, root encoding, CAS/lock/fsync/recovery order, quarantine discovery rules, support resolver, DREAM cache, and audit sidecars under separate human scope.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The estimands are appropriately narrow but are not executable or claim-bearing without prospectively frozen generators, rubrics, verdict rules, scoring, allocation, inference, controls, replay closure, and safety comparisons.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Before the relevant generation or execution, separately bind bootstrap generators and splits, semantic and structural audits, preservation verdicts, writer factorial, scoring and inference, multiplicity and stopping, replay closure and filler, directional controls, and safety comparators.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A rework adjudication is non-releasable and cannot be converted into technical passage by human ratification of these rejected bytes.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Permit only preparation of a successor proposal and fresh deliberation; keep implementation, model/tokenizer, data/benchmark, adapter, GPU/resource, external science, claim, publication, and push actions forbidden.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Authority must enter externally and be verified without an omniscient auditor or protected evidence, and it must bind the exhaustive first-affected-action scope.
The firewall must use separated eligible-life and control capabilities and prove direct and transitive taint across named operations and epochs.
Writer-route invariance must be tested through least-authority head/life capabilities with explicit operation direction and fresh-epoch constraints.
The model-free zero-effective-delta and gradient-flow invariant is unaffected by the seven blockers.
The reference merge, immutable content identity, tensor inventory, and parity invariant remains necessary as written.
It must fault separated head capabilities, operation directions, invocation epochs, exam/scorer/report stages, and narrow audit attestations in addition to retry classes.
The paired active-control and noncircular semantic audit remains valid, subject to its later exact data/rubric contract.
The blindness audit must be isolated from lineage audit, human authority verification, and release, with only a narrow attestation leaving the audit stage.
The clone assay must explicitly separate model-facing execution from hidden-truth scoring and reporting while preserving its Delta_R estimand.
It must prove cursor-only fixed teaching and split exam execution, truth scoring, and reporting in addition to equal opportunity and allowed outcome divergence.
The package estimand remains narrow, but its exams must use the separated executor/scorer/reporter pipeline with no feedback path.
The fixed arm must be tested with only immutable lesson bytes, monotone cursor access, and write-only audit append; generic mixed-state visibility is disallowed.
Source, extraction, and native-use probes must separate model execution, truth-bearing scoring, and reporting to prevent test-time truth or prior-product adaptation.
Disposable candidate probing must use the split executor/scorer/reporter firewall while retaining exact closure, filler, dose, and no-lineage-feedback semantics.
The conditional rank-by-exposure engineering assay is unaffected, subject to a separately frozen writer/evidence packet.
Checkpoint and terminal evaluations must pass through the separated executor, truth scorer, and reporting stages without changing its total-package and conditional labels.
Its frozen success/AUC/margin/root/spend semantics remain necessary but not sufficient; exact analysis, multiplicity, and safety contracts are still required before generation or execution.

A complete visible/derived/forbidden product is insufficient; the successor must test the full stage-by-information-by-operation-by-epoch capability product, transitive taint, split evaluation, split audit, and release isolation.
Life preservation and retry faults must operate through separate head capabilities and explicit epochs, with every covered action gated by the broadened prerequisite class.
Fresh review and GPU authority must use external human authorization plus a nonomniscient verifier and remain subordinate to the exhaustive first-affected-action registry.

The test must enumerate every CPU/GPU model, tokenizer, generation, data, evaluation, writer, adapter, candidate, promotion, benchmark, and external dispatch route and use a prerequisite label broader than model_execution.

Will the successor replace broad visibility with least-authority directional, epoch-scoped capabilities and split model execution, scoring, reporting, audits, external authority verification, and release?
Will every downstream implementation, data, model/tokenizer, adapter, GPU/resource, external-science, claim, publication, and push scope remain separately exact and human-gated?
